findings.message: Declaring an optional parameter before a required parameter is deprecated since PHP 8.0. Parameter $exchange_rate_to_vnd is optional, while parameter $paypal_currency is required. The $exchange_rate_to_vnd parameter is implicitly treated as a required parameter.
